title: ProStore E-Commerce website
description: Built a fully functional e-commerce web application that allows users to browse products, view detailed product pages, add items to a shopping cart, and complete secure checkouts. The platform features a responsive design, smooth user experience, and essential functionalities such as product filtering, search, and order management. Designed to provide a seamless shopping experience for users across all devices

title: Food Recepies Project
description: Created a dynamic Food Recipes web application that enables users to share their favorite recipes, browse dishes from other users, and explore a variety of cuisines. The platform encourages community engagement through user-generated content, making it easy for food enthusiasts to discover, save, and try out new recipes.

title: VansLife Website
description: Developed a van rental website where users can browse available vans, book rentals, and log in to access their personal accounts. The project was built using plain React.js, without additional frameworks, to gain a deeper understanding of core concepts. Implemented custom hooks for cleaner code and better state management, and focused on building reusable components and a smooth user experience throughout the app.
